observation: The previous WSL instance and its trainer were absent on continuation; the exact termination time and cause are unknown.
protocol: Resume the same last.pt and redo the incomplete second epoch. The first completed epoch remains in the raw CSV and epoch callback records. This is checkpoint recovery, not a new pretrained run.
elapsed_time_protocol: The final training timer sums completed epoch callback windows, including in-epoch validation and checkpoint work. It excludes initialization, the interruption gap and discarded incomplete-epoch work. Raw Ultralytics CSV time has an invocation-local origin and is preserved unchanged.
